==Breaking changes==
A number of [[console variables]] can no longer be changed while in combat: [http://us.battle.net/wow/en/forum/topic/12674209697]
*[[CVar alwaysShowActionBars|alwaysShowActionBars]]
*[[CVar bloatnameplates|bloatnameplates]]
*[[CVar bloatTest|bloatTest]]
*[[CVar bloatthreat|bloatthreat]]
*[[CVar consolidateBuffs|consolidateBuffs]]
*[[CVar fullSizeFocusFrame|fullSizeFocusFrame]]
*[[CVar maxAlgoplates|maxAlgoplates]]
*[[CVar nameplateMotion|nameplateMotion]]
*[[CVar nameplateOverlapH|nameplateOverlapH]]
*[[CVar nameplateOverlapV|nameplateOverlapV]]
*[[CVar nameplateShowEnemies|nameplateShowEnemies]]
*[[CVar nameplateShowEnemyGuardians|nameplateShowEnemyGuardians]]
*[[CVar nameplateShowEnemyPets|nameplateShowEnemyPets]]
*[[CVar nameplateShowEnemyTotems|nameplateShowEnemyTotems]]
*[[CVar nameplateShowFriendlyGuardians|nameplateShowFriendlyGuardians]]
*[[CVar nameplateShowFriendlyPets|nameplateShowFriendlyPets]]
*[[CVar nameplateShowFriendlyTotems|nameplateShowFriendlyTotems]]
*[[CVar nameplateShowFriends|nameplateShowFriends]]
*[[CVar repositionfrequency|repositionfrequency]]
*[[CVar showArenaEnemyFrames|showArenaEnemyFrames]]
*[[CVar showArenaEnemyPets|showArenaEnemyPets]]
*[[CVar showPartyPets|showPartyPets]]
*[[CVar showTargetOfTarget|showTargetOfTarget]]
*[[CVar targetOfTargetMode|targetOfTargetMode]]
*[[CVar uiScale|uiScale]]
*[[CVar useCompactPartyFrames|useCompactPartyFrames]]
*[[CVar useUiScale|useUiScale]]

Other changes:
*{{api|SetUIVisibility}}(false) is now protected in combat. Add-Ons can still use "SetUIVisibility(true)" while in combat, but you cannot toggle it. [http://us.battle.net/wow/en/forum/topic/12674209697?page=3#46]
